M64=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF; POLY=0xad93d23594c935a9
def reflect64(v):
    r=0
    for i in range(64): r=(r<<1)|((v>>i)&1)

def crc64raw(crc,data):
    for c in data:

import struct

def read_len(buf, i):
    b = buf[i]
    if (b & 0xC0) == 0x00: return b, i+1
    if (b & 0xC0) == 0x40: return ((b & 0x3F) << 8) | buf[i+1], i+2
    if (b & 0xC0) == 0x80: return int.from_bytes(buf[i+1:i+5], 'big'), i+5
    raise ValueError('special enc at %d: 0x%02x' % (i, b))

def read_str(buf, i):
    hdr = buf[i]
    if (hdr & 0xC0) == 0x00:
        ln = hdr & 0x3F; return buf[i+1:i+1+ln], i+1+ln
    if (hdr & 0xC0) == 0x40:
        ln = ((hdr & 0x3F) << 8) | buf[i+1]; return buf[i+2:i+2+ln], i+2+ln
    if (hdr & 0xC0) == 0x80:
        ln = int.from_bytes(buf[i+1:i+5], 'big'); return buf[i+5:i+5+ln], i+5+ln
    if hdr == 0xC0:  # 8-bit int
        return ('int8', buf[i+1]), i+2
    if hdr == 0xC1:  # 16-bit int LE
        return ('int16', int.from_bytes(buf[i+1:i+3],'little')), i+3
    if hdr == 0xC2:  # 32-bit int LE
        return ('int32', int.from_bytes(buf[i+1:i+5],'little')), i+5
    raise ValueError('str special enc 0x%02x at %d' % (hdr, i))

def parse_stream_obj(buf):
    """buf excludes the type byte? No - include everything after RESTORE prefix; assume starts with type"""

    fms, i = read_len(buf, i); fsq, i = read_len(buf, i)
    out['first_id'] = (fms, fsq)
    mms, i = read_len(buf, i); msq, i = read_len(buf, i)
    out['maxdel'] = (mms, msq)
    ea, i = read_len(buf, i); out['entries_added'] = ea
    ng, i = read_len(buf, i); out['groups'] = []
    for _ in range(ng):
        nm, i = read_str(buf, i)
        g = {'name': nm}
        g['last_ms'], i = read_len(buf, i); g['last_seq'], i = read_len(buf, i)
        g['entries_read'], i = read_len(buf, i)

            nack_ms = struct.unpack('<q', buf[i:i+8])[0]; i += 8
            nack_cnt, i = read_len(buf, i)
